# process

Supervise a long-running process scoped to the plan or session

## Examples

```yaml
# Start ollama for the duration of this plan
- name: Start ollama
  process:
    name: ollama
    command: [ollama, serve]
    scope: plan
    health:
      port_open: 11434
      timeout: 30s
```

```yaml
# Ensure a session-scoped helper is running
- name: Ensure helper running
  process:
    name: my-helper
    command: [/usr/local/bin/my-helper, --port, "9000"]
    state: running
    health:
      port_open: 9000
```

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
